22432.overview: Welcome to Malibu: Volleyball capital of the world. This is where the best come to play--and show off their tans. If you want in, sign up. But keep your eyes on the ball...there'll be plenty of time for bikini-watching after the match!

22433.overview:
Marlboro Lynx was a specially designed Lynx, which was made explicitly to place the Marlboro brand in front of what Phillip Morris hoped would be a future-smoker. 

It came with a dirt bike -game "Marlboro Go!", which only featured a single level and was never supposed to be released;  the concept was to hold contests at expos and if participants made it through the track, they were given various prizes. It was only used in Germany.

22434.overview: With classic style and tradition, Ms. Pac-Man munches her way through maze after maze. She will consume all the dots in a level before she can progress to the next level. That can be pretty tough though, because at the same time she must dodge those devious gobbling ghosts!

449226.overview: The fun is just beginning in this explosive pack of games and tools for your Lynx! Enjoy the arcade action of ChopperX or Parafly, or kick back and relax with Password, High Roller or Blackjack. Looking for something really different? Give Sketch or Soundtool a whirl! No matter how you slice it, no Lynx fan will be disappointed with MegaPak 1!

450435.overview: In this homebrew remake of the game for the Atari Lynx by Matthias Domin, you control a marble on its course through the level as fast as possible. Watch out for the monsters! There are seven levels to overcome in the 1999 update for the game.
